description: This file provides security utilities for handling untrusted external content, including functions for detecting suspicious patterns, wrapping content with security boundaries, and managing external content sources and markers.

methods.name: detectSuspiciousPatterns
methods.description: Checks if content contains suspicious patterns that may indicate prompt injection or malicious content.

methods.name: wrapExternalContent
methods.description: Wraps external untrusted content with security boundaries and warnings for safe processing.

methods.name: buildSafeExternalPrompt
methods.description: Builds a secure prompt for external content, including contextual information and security warnings.

methods.name: isExternalHookSession
methods.description: Determines if a session key indicates an external hook source.

methods.name: getHookType
methods.description: Extracts the hook type from a session key.

methods.name: wrapWebContent
methods.description: Wraps web search or fetch content with security markers.
